# Preserve required review parent stacks

The imported Task 4 summary reports that macOS `git apply --index` failed on D331825's case-only `SearchDialog.js` to `searchDialog.js` rename. It reports an index-based workaround in `lib/mozphab-review/sitecustomize.py` that allowed the required D331825–D331827 stack and excluded child D331828. For this review workflow, parent application failure must produce an explicit error rather than silently retry with `--skip-dependencies`, which removes required context. This is a provisional historical report; check current moz-phab behavior before applying the workaround elsewhere.

Scope: console moz-phab review.
